title: Notifications
notes: Notifications list migrated onto ListPage archetype (PageHeader+count, FilterBar, DataTable hover actions Eye/Trash2, useInfiniteScroll via archetype, EmptyState, bulk select + bulk delete/mark-read, themed CSV export that paginates the full filtered dataset). Row click marks read and deep-links via actionUrl/referenceType+referenceId (#65 fixed at this layer). detailDrawer intentionally false — a notification's 'detail' is the target entity it deep-links to, not a standalone record; sendMessageDialog/relationCombobox/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput not applicable to this entity. datePicker set to false — the quiet-hours inputs are hour-of-day pickers (type="time"), not calendar dates, so DatePicker doesn't apply; left as plain Input. Settings→Notifications and Announcements pages left functionally as-is (already token-based forms) except two raw Tailwind color patches replaced with ds- tokens on the announcement preview card. Could not fix: prefs channel/type format mismatch (#23), quiet-hours enable/disable semantics (#24), sidebar badge (#27, file outside allowlist) — these need backend/sidebar changes outside this slice's fileAllowlist.
showcaseScript: Open Notifications and filter to unread
Click a notification and deep-link to the record
Mark all as read and watch the sidebar badge clear
Open Settings → Notifications and set quiet hours
